title: Plant Phenology Pipeline Configuration
description: Schema for configuration adhering to T004 requirements.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project root directory.

data_dir.description: Absolute path to the data directory.

raw_data_dir.description: Absolute path to the raw data subdirectory.

processed_data_dir.description: Absolute path to the processed data subdirectory.

artifacts_dir.description: Absolute path to the artifacts directory.

models_dir.description: Absolute path to the models subdirectory.

api_keys.description: Dictionary of API keys. Keys are service names, values are secret strings.

gee_credentials_path.description: Path to the Google Earth Engine service account JSON file.

nature_notebook_api_key.description: API key for Nature's Notebook (NN) service.
